SELECT * FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT_PARAM

IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 CNT FROM OM.OM_TASK_RUN WHERE TASK_NAME='TSK_EDS_CUSTOMER_TOTAL_REL' AND PROCESS_DATE=CAST('9999-10-08' AS DATE))
BEGIN
   DELETE FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_TOTAL_REL WHERE AS_OF_DATE = CAST('2024-10-08' AS DATE);
END;
